---
title: "A small INT8 neural network for autonomous obstacle avoidance"
---

## AI Model

It is a realistic example of an AI agent running directly on a microcontroller.

Application: A two-wheel autonomous robot that moves through a room and avoids obstacles.

AI model: A small fully connected neural network (MLP) that receives distance measurements and predicts the safest movement direction.

A practical starting architecture could be:

$$\boxed{3\rightarrow 16 \rightarrow 8 \rightarrow 2}$$

- 3 inputs: Left, front, and right distance measurements
- 16 neurons: First hidden layer
- 8 neurons: Second hidden layer
- 2 outputs: Steering and speed

The model would be trained on a computer, then quantized to INT8 and deployed to the STM32 using STM32Cube.AI.

## The agent and environment

The neural network is the decision-making model; the agent is the complete robot system that uses the model.

The environment is the physical world surrounding the robot. In this specific AI model:

- Walls
- Tables
- Chairs
- People
- Other obstacles
- Floor surface
- Battery and motor conditions

The environment changes when the robot moves.
